subject: Reminder: Friday drafts
text:
Reminder: the report drafts are due Friday at noon, not next Monday.
I rechecked the calendar invite. The date shown on your screens looked different because the meeting notes linked to an old version. That mix-up is on me for sending two files yesterday.
To keep us aligned: each section owner should upload one clean file to the shared folder. Name it by section and initials. Do not email copies, since the server locks versions. If you need access, reply within two hours. I will add you manually.
Finance, please confirm the tables. Operations, send updated figures by Thursday afternoon so finance has ample time. Design, keep the graphics reasonably simple and readable. Everyone else, leave comments in the master document rather than adding new paragraphs directly. Keep the summary under one page. Cite sources with footnotes. If a number changes, note it.
If Friday is impossible, say so today. Give me one workable time before end of day. I will rebook the review and flag the final submission date. Please also confirm whether the client needs a plain language version. If yes, mark the relevant charts. I need one owner for that before noon Thursday.
I know calendars can display times oddly. Going forward, I will post the deadline in the message body and not rely only on the invite. Thanks for handling the correction quickly. Send questions now, not at the last minute. Upload a PDF once, not every five minutes. I appreciate your patience with schedule shifts.
